candidate.definition_en: Used to give your own opinion; or doing something yourself rather than asking someone else.
candidate.explanation_ar: لما تعمل حاجة بنفسك مش حد تاني، أو لما تقول رأيك الخاص.

senses.definition_en: Used to introduce your personal viewpoint or opinion
senses.definition_ar: للتعبير عن الرأي الخاص (عن نفسي أو من وجهة نظري)
examples: Personally, I prefer to work in the morning.

senses.definition_en: By oneself directly, rather than through an intermediary or representative
In a personal manner, often interpreting remarks as an offense or direct criticism
senses.definition_ar: بشكل شخصي يمس المشاعر أو الكرامة
examples: You shouldn't take his comments personally.
You shouldn't take his comments personally.
I am personally responsible for this error.
